title: a component at the repo root reads only its own repo
intention: encapsulation_holds judges a component that sits at the repo root (bin) against that repo alone: _repo_of takes a census root that itself holds a cairn/ package as the repo, never its parent, and the row's own address is its path relative to that repo, so bin's breaches land on bin.
why: Measured 2026-11-18: the PROVED crossing of ticket 8c5fdb750b75 (component bin) was refused twice with 'no reply from codemother within 120.0s'. py-spy on the bus (pid 986008, 100% CPU) showed the bus-ask thread inside import_sieve.import_sites with repo_root=/home/akien/dev/src: transitions.inspect_build passes root=comp_dir.parent, which for bin is the repo ~/dev/src/cairn, and _repo_of returns the parent of any root named cairn, so the sweep parsed all 85 worktrees under ~/dev/src (the same repo alone takes 7.1 s, 6193 sites). The row address is then 'cairn/bin' while breaches are keyed 'bin', so the sweep could never land a breach on bin.
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation_holds is its physics) and Law 8 (a gate that cannot answer in time refuses a real crossing; a row keyed off its breaches is a hollow green).
how: inspector.py: _repo_of returns the census root itself when it holds a cairn/ directory (a repo root named cairn), else the parent when named cairn, else itself. encapsulation_holds computes here as comp_dir's path relative to repo_root and the census set as each row's dir relative to repo_root, so the live shape (cairn/devices/x) is unchanged. The proof lays <tmp>/cairn as a repo root holding a cairn/ package and bin/, with a stray breach-shaped worktree at <tmp>/wt-x, shaped like cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_a_census_root_outside_a_repo_reads_only_itself.py.

clauses.claim: with the census root at <tmp>/cairn holding a cairn/ package and a bin/ component, encapsulation_holds for row bin hands import_sieve.import_sites only <tmp>/cairn, and a breach-shaped .py under a sibling <tmp>/wt-x is not read
a cross-device import planted in <tmp>/cairn/bin/ reds on row bin
the live shape <tmp>/cairn/devices/a (census root <tmp>/cairn with no cairn/ child) still takes <tmp> as the repo and still reds a cross-device import on row devices/a

decisions.text: D1: inspector.py: _repo_of takes a census root holding a cairn/ directory as the repo itself; encapsulation_holds keys here and the census set relative to repo_root.

D2: the proof lays a repo-root-shaped fixture with a stray sibling worktree and a bin breach, one tooth per clause, shaped like cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_a_census_root_outside_a_repo_reads_only_itself.py.

out: cairn/tools/base/transitions.py (the gate's root choice is unchanged)

measured.saw: the bus-ask thread of the clearance for 8c5fdb750b75 in import_sites with repo_root=/home/akien/dev/src, the bus at 100% CPU for minutes; the repo alone sweeps in 7.1 s
measured.how: sudo py-spy dump --locals on the bus pid; timed import_sieve.import_sites('.') in ~/dev/src/cairn
